more_beautiful.reason: On the phone, A's Kaiti title, seal and brush stroke over warm paper cards with a deep-red pressable button form a finished, inviting hierarchy, while B's plain sans header, heavy black button, lopsided option cards and single-character orphans (“字”, “书”) feel austere and less polished despite its lovely 米字格 specimens.

less_generic.reason: B's 米字格 practice grids holding 楷/行 specimens, with a teacher's red circle drawn round the chosen character, are ideas only a calligraphy class would have, whereas A's red seal, brush underline and rounded shadowed cards are a familiar 中国风 kit that could easily be AI-made.

better_overall.reason: A is the safer page for 70-year-olds and for the school: bigger type, errors that jump straight to the faulty field, a check-before-submit step showing the phone as 138 1234 5678, an unmistakable success screen, correct handling of family members sharing one phone, and a password-protected roster with CSV export, whereas B overwrites a registration when two people share a phone and gives the owner no roster view.

A: Very large, legible type (about 26px inputs and fact values, 46px Kaiti title) and 64–70px controls; every field and choice card is easy to tap.

A flow built for older users: '下一步：核对信息' leads to a review page with the phone shown as 138 1234 5678; the success screen has a big check, '报名成功', a '接下来' box and '再帮别人报名'; the phone's Back button returns to the form instead of leaving the page.

Plain-language errors next to each field ('手机号是 11 位数字，您填了 10 位') that scroll to the first problem and clear as soon as it is fixed; forgiving input (+86, full-width digits, stray spaces, ethnic-name dots).

Owner value: one config file for schedule, fee, classes, location and contact (empty optional rows simply disappear), a password-protected roster grouped by class with tap-to-call numbers and a CSV export that opens in Excel/WPS, a no-JavaScript fallback and dark mode.
Duplicates are matched on name plus phone, so an older couple can sign up from one phone, and the same person cannot register twice.
Conversational, senior-friendly copy: '每周三 下午 2 点到 4 点', '一共 3 项，都要填写', '老师会打这个电话联系您'.
B: A specific concept: 米字格 practice grids with 楷 and 行 specimens, and choosing a class draws a red teacher's circle round the character, which is unmistakably a calligraphy class.
Simplest possible operation: one '提交报名' tap, plus '修改报名信息' afterwards to correct a mistake, and a thoughtful '可以把这一页截图留着'.
Handles missing information honestly and up front: '上课地点、开课日期和交费方式，学校会用您留的手机号通知您'.
Solid accessible error handling (a linked summary plus inline messages), a very clear selected state (border, fill, red circle, '已选'), high contrast and large whole-card tap targets.
A considered desktop layout, with course facts on the left and the form on the right.

A: The visual language is a stock 中国风 kit (red seal, brush underline, rounded cards with soft shadows, a 3D button) and reads like a polished template.
The review step adds a tap to a three-field form, against the brief's '操作要简单'.
Says nothing on the main page about location, start date or payment, and invents a process ('老师会打这个电话联系您', '我们会尽快打电话和您确认').
The class-switch message says '想换班，请联系老师' but shows no contact unless the owner fills it in; the full-width colon leaves a visible gap in the main button.
Desktop is just a long centred column.
B: The plain bold-sans title and near-black main button make the page feel austere and less warm for older visitors; only the option cards carry the theme.

Chinese typesetting slips at 375px: single-character orphans ('字', '书') in both class descriptions, crowded by the heavy side padding in the option cards, and the class name floats above an empty band.
When the same phone signs up for the same class again, the earlier entry is overwritten, so an older couple sharing one phone would lose a registration.
The owner gets no roster view (only a CSV file on the server's disk), and course text is hard-coded in several files.
Errors move focus to a summary at the top rather than to the field; the confirmation '报名已提交' is subtler than a clear success mark; the 行 specimen is set in 楷体, not 行书.
